_comment: CURATED 'state of the realm' digest for the Meta tab. Re-researched 2026-10 from DECA patch notes (remaster.realmofthemadgod.com + hub.realmofthemadgod.com), RealmEye wiki, and the RealmEye drop tables in dungeon-drops.json. Full write-up + sources: META.md. '~' dates are approximate. Update this when a new season lands.
current: Season 31 Part 1 (Halloween) is on Public Testing; Season 30 Part 2 — Time Chamber (Month of the Mad God) is live.

timeline.name: Emberbloom Cycle
highlights: New class: Druid — Wand + Leather, Sigil ability; build meter by casting/hitting, then shapeshift (e.g. Shark = stealth rusher, Golem = tank).
Phoenix Crucible: +15% ATT/DEX for −10 DEF / −15% HP, +15% loot.

timeline.name: Hydroflow
highlights: Reskinned T6 abilities + new engraving.
Hydroflow Crucible: +12 SPD/+12 WIS/+20% MP for −ATT/−DEX/−25% VIT, +10% loot.

timeline.name: The Return of Stromwell
highlights: Realm Legions: Oryx's Legion occupies the realm; Veteran biomes host the Legion Watchtower, Strategy Center and Research Base.
Legion Elite gear (T13 weapon/armor, T6 ability equivalents) + the Nightmatter Circlet ST ring via Stromwell Rifts I/II/III.
Dungeon Mod rework: every mod now carries a loot, XP or dust boost — harder mods, bigger boost.

timeline.name: Alien Invasion
highlights: Alien Invasion reworked: can start at 15% Realm Score; Alien Reactors in the Adept biomes are the source of aliens.
Necromancer + skull rework, Summoner modernization, new realm event: The Jötunn.

timeline.name: Alien Overdrive
highlights: Neo Wormholes (difficulty 8): grant an EXALT — the wormhole's colour sets the stat — but only if you beat the timer AND kill the Satellite Core.
Upgraded Alien gear, new Essences.

timeline.name: Retrowinds
highlights: Mystic rework: weapon hits stack Hex on enemies (up to 100; drops after 3s without a new stack).

Six new community encounters: Artificial Slop (Haunted Hallows), Cold Soul + Stygian Mirror (Risen Hell), Towering Perfection (Sprite Forest), Man-eating Barnacle (Coral Reefs), Cube Deity (Deep Sea Abyss).
Retrowinds T13 reskins, Wind Vortex encounters in feature dungeons.

timeline.name: Time Chamber (Month of the Mad God)
highlights: Time Chamber: 12 portals to classic dungeon versions with their ORIGINAL loot tables (easiest at 12 o'clock, harder clockwise). Legacy Shatters grants an ATT exalt.
Trials of Cronus rework: pure 5-round boss rush (no minion waves), 2 boss choices per round, expects 6/8.
Onboarding: systems unlock by account level — Pets 5, Enchanter 17, Forge 23, Crucible 27.

timeline.name: Halloween (Public Testing)
highlights: Blood Rituals return; Memories = short solo story encounters.
New Crucible: +30% VIT, −30% external healing, +10% loot/XP.
Druid ST reskin + new Halloween UTs.

rules: Level 1→20 in the Rookie biomes (Beach → Forest/Plains/Desert). Stat pots don't start dropping until the Adept biomes.
Adept biomes drop the 6 stat pots; Veteran biomes add Life & Mana. Activate a biome's Beacon (kill its Guardian) for fast-travel + a safe heal zone.
Guaranteed early pots: Sprite World (DEX), Snake Pit (SPD), Undead Lair (WIS), Abyss (VIT), Toxic Sewers (DEF), Puppet Master's Theatre (ATT).
Life & Mana are MID-game now: Woodland Labyrinth drops Life and The Crawling Depths / Ocean Trench drop Mana — all three spawn in Veteran biomes.
At 8/8, switch to exalts. Fastest: The Nest (DEX), Ice Citadel (SPD), Kogbold (VIT). Fungal → Crystal Cavern = 2 WIS per chain; The Shatters = 2 ATT per run.
Advanced / Plagued dungeons: you heal 50% less, but +30% loot, extra dust and 5× artifact rate.
Dungeon mods and the seasonal Crucible trade difficulty for loot/XP — opt in once your character can handle it.
O3 needs three runes: Sword (Nest / Kogbold / Crystal Cavern), Shield (Cnidarian Reef / Lair of Shaitan / Secluded Thicket), Helmet (Lost Halls / Cultist / Void).
Grind the exalt dungeon that's on a Double Exaltation calendar event — it's literally twice as fast.
corrections: Ice CAVE grants no exalt — the SPD exalt is its rebuild, the Ice Citadel (Esben the Neurotic, Runic Tundra).
The Void grants Mana only — the Vial of Pure Darkness just opens it.
The Shatters grants Attack only, but TWICE per run (Twilight Archmage + Forgotten King) — not Life/Mana.
Ocean Trench drops Mana, not Life. Manor of the Immortals drops ATT, not WIS.
Crystal Cavern isn't an Easter seasonal — it's entered from the Fungal Cavern boss.
Kogbold → VIT and Fungal/Crystal → WIS (the old notes had them swapped).
'Advanced Nest' is now the Plagued Nest; Advanced dungeons trade extra damage for −50% healing.
